text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 公寓异界门.
Environment: Apartment threshold with a luminous otherworldly portal, domestic doorway and transition between ordinary interior and magical light.
Visual medium: otome 2d5d 3d; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Use case: spatial production design. Create 建筑图 for 公寓异界门. Image 1 is the geometric source of truth. Image 2 is original material and style reference. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. Keep the plan footprint, doors, windows, fixed landmarks and circulation exactly consistent. Concept reconstruction, not measured construction. Match original color palette and rendering style, detailed legible clean image, landscape. NO people, animals, silhouettes or figures on posters. No fake measurements, no watermarks. Only bottom left of image 2 depicts target apartment portal; ignore other panels.
